sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "wine"."Appelation" AS e, AVG((CAST("wine"."Price" AS REAL) / "wine"."Score")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "wine" GROUP BY "wine"."Appelation"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: wine.bottle price per critic rating score
why: bottle price / critic rating score: the catalogue declares bottle price a rate over critic rating score
average of bottle price per critic rating score per appellations (by Appelation)
index against the all average of average of bottle price per critic rating score (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "wine"."Grape" AS e, AVG("wine"."Cases") AS m1, AVG((CAST("wine"."Price" AS REAL) / "wine"."Score")) AS m2 FROM "wine" GROUP BY "wine"."Grape"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

why: average of number of cases produced per grapes (by Grape)

average of bottle price per critic rating score per grapes (by Grape)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "wine"."Appelation" AS e, AVG((CAST("wine"."Price" AS REAL) / "wine"."Score")) AS m1 FROM "wine" GROUP BY "wine"."Appelation"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
